# dataversecontact_table (Data Source)

Reads a single table's published schema from the Dataverse Contact API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dataversecontact_table" "case" {
  scope      = "default"
  route_name = "case"
}

output "dataverse_table" {
  value = data.dataversecontact_table.case.dataverse_table
}

output "field_count" {
  value = data.dataversecontact_table.case.field_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `route_name` (String) The table's route name.
- `scope` (String) The scope to read the table from.

### Read-Only

- `dataverse_logical_name` (String) The Dataverse entity logical name.
- `dataverse_table` (String) The Dataverse OData entity set name.
- `field_count` (Number) Number of fields defined in the schema.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format {scope}/{route_name}.
- `primary_key` (String) The primary key field name.
- `required_permission` (String) The base permission name.
- `schema_json` (String) The full table schema as a JSON string.
- `source` (String) The source ("published", "built-in", "draft").
